stem.text: The warning signal on an ambulance has a frequency of $600\,\text{Hz}$. The speed of sound is $330\,\text{m s}^{-1}$. The ambulance is travelling with a constant velocity of $25\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ towards an observer.

stem.alt: Diagram showing an ambulance marked by a dot with a rightward arrow at its initial position on the left and at its final position on the right, with an observer marked by a dot between them.

stem.text: Which overall change in observed frequency takes place between the times at which the ambulance is a long way behind the observer and when it is a long way in front of the observer?
